<thought>We need a template that forms a sulfonamide (S–N bond) and breaks the S–Cl bond of a sulfonyl chloride in the forward reaction. Using a representative product (benzenesulfonamide) we search for templates that form the S‑N bond (16‑7) and break the S‑Cl bond (16‑17) while forming the “sulfonamides” functional group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "bonds_formed": ["16-7"],
    "bonds_broken": ["16-17"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
